case.summary: Transaction 3509359 ($125.08, online) was flagged by the real-time detection model with a moderate risk score of 0.52. Evidence reviewed included the customer's established profile of 112 transactions, recent card activity showing mostly low-risk in-person purchases, a generic device fingerprint linked to many users, and similar prior cleared cases. Additional evidence was not requested because the transaction details and customer history provided sufficient context to assess the risk. Following the bank's guidelines—which treat risk scores as investigation triggers rather than verdicts and note no specific fraud pattern (such as card testing under R2 or R5)—the recommended action is to verify the transaction with the customer (`VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER`).
